headline: GOLD HITS $4,750 AND SILVER SURGES 7% WEEKLY AS IRAN PEACE TALKS LIFT PRECIOUS METALS
snippet: Spot gold jumped 1.2% to $4,750/oz and silver added 3% to trade above $79 — its highest since mid-March — as optimism over a potential US-Iran peace deal eased inflation fears. Analysts say the structural bull market in precious metals resumes once geopolitical fog clears; gold is up 42% year-over-year.

headline: GOLDSEEK COT MAY 8: SILVER NET LONGS BUILD AS CHINA HOOVERS UP 790+ TONNES IN EARLY 2026
snippet: The May 8 Commitments of Traders report shows speculative longs in gold and silver holding firm. A related GoldSeek SWOT analysis highlights China's 790+ tonne silver import surge in early 2026 — largely solar-driven — as a structural demand pillar, even as spot prices trade near multi-year highs above $79/oz.

headline: COPPER BLASTS THROUGH $6.20/LB AS CHINA BANS SULPHURIC ACID EXPORTS AND U.S. TARIFF CLOCK TICKS
snippet: Copper futures hit $6.20/lb — up 36% year-over-year — as China halted sulphuric acid exports from May, directly threatening roughly 15% of global copper mine output. A proposed 15% U.S. import tariff slated for January 2027 (rising to 30% by 2028) adds further pressure on an already strained supply picture.

headline: SILVER47 HITS 38.7 G/T GOLD AND 1,713 G/T SILVER ON LARGELY UNTESTED 15KM NEVADA VEIN NETWORK
snippet: Silver47 Exploration (TSXV: AGA) tripled the Kennedy project footprint to 6,150 acres in Nevada after headline rock samples returned 38.7 g/t Au and 1,713 g/t Ag. The 15km vein network is largely untested; a 3,000-sample soil geochemistry grid and induced-polarization geophysics are next, with drilling at the adjacent Hughes project ongoing.

headline: HONEY BADGER SILVER ROCKETS 63% ON TSXV TO 52-WEEK HIGH AFTER CLOSING PC SILVER ACQUISITION
snippet: Honey Badger Silver (TSXV: TUF) was the top TSX-V gainer this week, surging 63% after closing its acquisition of the PC Silver Project in the Northwest Territories. Shares hit a new 52-week high of C$0.76, catching a tailwind from silver trading above $79/oz and the company's expanded project portfolio.

headline: OPUS ONE GOLD DRILLS 8.22 G/T AU OVER 8.5M AT NOYELL — ABITIBI WINTER PROGRAM EXTENDS ZONE 1
snippet: Opus One Gold (TSXV: OOR) released further winter drill results from Noyell in Quebec's northern Abitibi greenstone belt. Hole NO-26-07 returned 8.22 g/t Au over 8.5 metres; multiple holes are now testing Zone 1's western extension to 350–500m vertical depth. More results expected in coming weeks.

headline: Q1 MINING M&A HITS $21.6 BILLION — STRONGEST START SINCE 2023 AS GOLD COMMANDS 77% OF DEAL VALUE
snippet: Global mining M&A totalled $21.6 billion across 121 transactions in Q1 2026, the strongest opening quarter since 2023. Gold and silver assets drove 77% of deal value. The sector builds on a 13-year high of $93.7 billion in total 2025 M&A, with supply-chain security and critical minerals driving strategic buyer logic.

headline: ZIJIN'S C$5.5B ALLIED GOLD TAKEOVER NEARS MAY 29 DEADLINE AS MALI MINES RUN NORMALLY
snippet: Allied Gold (TSX: AAUC) confirmed its three African open-pit gold mines are operating normally as Zijin Gold International's C$5.5 billion all-cash takeover heads toward its May 29 outside closing date. Shareholders voted 77% in favour on March 31; Chinese regulatory sign-off is the remaining hurdle.

headline: STANDARD URANIUM LOCKS IN 2026 DRILL PLAN FOR DAVIDSON RIVER IN SOUTHWEST ATHABASCA BASIN
snippet: Standard Uranium (TSXV: STND) finalized its 2026 drill program at the Davidson River Project in Saskatchewan's southwest Athabasca Basin, targeting multiple conductor corridors. The drill plan arrives as uranium spot prices climb back above $100/lb and Denison Mines' Phoenix ISR mine — Canada's first new uranium mine in decades — enters construction.

headline: USA RARE EARTH'S $2.8B SERRA VERDE DEAL: CAN ONE BRAZIL MINE CRACK CHINA'S RARE EARTH MONOPOLY?
snippet: USA Rare Earth's (NASDAQ: USAR) $2.8 billion acquisition of Brazil's Serra Verde — the only scaled producer of all four magnetic rare earths (Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb) outside Asia — challenges China's 90% grip on rare earth processing. Analysis examines whether a single mine plus U.S. government offtake backing can meaningfully shift supply risk.

headline: 100+ U.S. LITHIUM PROJECTS PROPOSED COAST TO COAST AS BATTERY DEMAND TRIGGERS MINING LAND RUSH
snippet: More than 100 new lithium extraction sites have been proposed across the United States as EV battery demand surges and battery-grade lithium prices recover 125% from their June 2025 trough. By 2030, at least six new U.S. mines are expected in production, with 13 more in late-stage development — mostly in the dry Southwest.

headline: AGNICO EAGLE AND BHP: TWO MINING STOCKS TO BUY IN MAY AS GOLD HOLDS ABOVE $4,700
snippet: Published May 9: Motley Fool analyst makes the case for Agnico Eagle as the go-to senior gold miner and BHP as a diversified copper play, arguing that mining equities remain undervalued relative to record commodity prices. Gold is trading above $4,700 and copper is above $6/lb, yet major miners trade at a discount to historical EV/EBITDA multiples.
